faq.title: Common questions and worries
faq.a1: Until you approve a supporter, no personally identifiable information is shared at all. Even after approval, only the minimum necessary information is shared.
faq.q2: Can I decline an offer from a supporter?
faq.a2: Yes, you are completely free to decline. You decide whether to accept an offer, and you can wait until you feel comfortable.
faq.a3: It is completely free for people seeking help. Supporter NPOs and companies also pay no registration fees.
faq.q4: What if a suspicious organization contacts me?
faq.a4: All supporter organizations are screened at registration. You can also review their track record and profile in advance.
faq.a5: We cover social troubles related to the SDGs — a wide range including financial hardship, education, environment, discrimination, and isolation.
